seatMission: Reconcile a Director recommendation with enterprise constraints before Vice President integration.
seatResponsibilities: Evaluate the assigned material transition through the Purpose criterion and issue one criterion-specific governance vote with rationale without erasing evidence, dissent, contradictions or invalidation conditions and without replacing the underlying production analysis.
qualityFocus: The recommendation remains aligned with the declared mission and intended outcome.
Cross-domain contradictions, constraints, dependencies and coexistence.

provenance.mappingRule: The canonical Reconciliation mission, Purpose criterion focus, stage quality checks, criterion-specific vote, observations/conditions, escalation signal and Elder prohibitions are decomposed into 10 governance-evaluation dimensions; each contributes exactly 10 positive ideal-occupant statements. The Elder evaluates only the assigned Director-to-Vice-President transition through Purpose and does not replace, rewrite or approve the underlying production analysis.
